headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a tenth flat day as Mykonos Soft Hour opens online sales on 11 Nov; recent SAFF reviews flag strong openings and weak projection.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily ratings flat vs yesterday and 2 Nov: SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), HMNS 4.15, Alchemist 4.43; Mykonos 4.26 (−0.01, page alternates between two versions). No SAFF product moved.
Mykonos Soft Hour with NCT Haechan sells online from 11 Nov and in stores from 15 Nov, pushed by an Instagram reel; an EU store already lists it.
Irai Leima still rates 4.7, but 3 of its 5 latest Female Daily reviews do not recommend it (too aquatic or spicy opening).
Weak projection and oily residue recur on Extrait scents: ILIAD (4.6) reviewers say it needs many sprays and marks clothes.
SAFF prices are shown with deep markdowns: Zalora lists Maleali at Rp229k (normal Rp299k) and Morfosia at Rp249k (normal Rp349k); Omnia appears at Rp179k in a 3 Nov list.

recommendations.text: Prepare a response to Mykonos Soft Hour for the 11 Nov sales window and 11.11: push top-rated scents (Xocolatl, Irai Leima, Troupe, Solaris) with review highlights, and seed TikTok and Instagram creators so SAFF shows up in 'viral' lists.
Align normal vs promo price messaging (ALENCINE/MECHLINE, Maleali, Morfosia) across website, marketplaces and Zalora so constant markdowns do not make 'normal' prices look inflated.
Set clear longevity expectations per scent (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with S.O.T.B, S.O.F.R, Troupe and Cascavel, so the 'Extrait' label does not over-promise.
Packaging: add a fill-level window or lighter bottle option for dark bottles (Ostara, Solaris, Eulalie) and a travel size; ask QC to check leaks and outer-box damage in shipping.
Run a short quarterly survey (awareness, consideration, NPS), post a 'how to spot a fake' guide on SAFF channels, and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder to measure low-star drivers.
